effects.minified.description: Cheap, minified-JSON-friendly single-filter dim look — one effect entry instead of the 3-entry oldComputer stack. Useful when generation budget/token count for the resolved scene matters.

timing.quickFollow.description: Fixed-offset follow-on timing anchor for a chained reveal (0.15s-ish at 30fps): fires 5 frames after asset id 'prev'. Static (no vars) — for a parametrized version use timing.withPreviousExit instead.
